main_primary: native utility_dynamic minus current relevance; all-assigned end-to-end answer EM
main_secondary: native utility_dynamic minus utility_static; only tested confirmatorily after primary success
main_test: two-sided exact McNemar alpha=0.05; positive delta required
mechanism_primary: masked full minus frozen_refresh; all supporting document titles available
mechanism_secondary: answer EM, descriptive unless separately registered
ci: paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 draws, question unit, seed 17
structural_failures: block the entire study, retain all assigned ids
eligibility: 10 unique public-context titles, screened before assignment; conflicting title texts get versioned document ids shared by every group
same_context_policy: one shared first bounded reader response per full context-policy key
